description: A towering foundry of black iron and grey granite, worked by golems. Clear the Quarry and Conduit wings from the Crucible, then climb to the Forgemaster. Level 37 raid.

actions.text: Granite Bull falls. A lift to the Crucible is ready.
The Corrupted Core falls. A lift to the Crucible is ready.
The Forgemaster falls. The Golem Forge goes cold.
The wall cracks open onto a hidden vault.
